result.improved: The plant can stabilize and slowly recover lost reserves.
result.stabilized: Acute pressure was contained, but still matters in the background.
result.worsened: Stress remained active and kept weighing on growth or stability.
result.escalated: Pressure developed into a clearer follow-up problem.
result.unresolved: The plant remains vulnerable for now, even without hard escalation.

guidance.improved: Keep the correction steady and watch for stable values.
guidance.stabilized: The situation is contained, but still needs one to two clean follow-up cycles.
guidance.worsened: Pressure is not resolved yet. Small targeted corrections beat rushed reactions.
guidance.escalated: The situation keeps escalating. Prioritize containment over growth pushes.
guidance.unresolved: Watch the next cycles and only correct the real trigger.

problem_source.water_wet: The medium stayed wet too long, reducing oxygen in the root zone.
problem_source.water_dry: The root ball dried out too far and the plant had to compensate for water stress.
problem_source.nutrition_lockout: Uptake was unstable. EC or pH drift shifted nutrient availability.
problem_source.nutrition_deficit: The current nutrient buffer no longer matched this growth phase.
problem_source.disease_mold: Humidity, low airflow, or dense canopy pushed the microclimate out of balance.
problem_source.environment_heat_dry: Heat and dry airflow increased transpiration pressure.
problem_source.environment_cold: Temperatures dropped too far and slowed metabolism and water uptake.
problem_source.environment_light: Light intensity and canopy distance were too aggressive for the current condition.
problem_source.generic: Multiple stressors built up over time and created the current pressure.

checkPotWeight.label: Check pot weight
checkPotWeight.short: Helps you read watering timing with more confidence.
checkPotWeight.description: Compares feel and moisture picture without forcing a watering move.
checkPotWeight.success: Pot weight checked. The water timing is easier to judge now.

moistenSurface.label: Moisten surface
moistenSurface.short: Small correction for a dry top layer.
moistenSurface.description: Calms only the surface without pushing the root zone too hard.
moistenSurface.success: Surface lightly moistened. The top layer looks calmer now.

evenWatering.label: Water evenly
evenWatering.short: Moderate watering for a clean dryback window.
evenWatering.description: Stabilises moisture and dry stress without feeling aggressive.
evenWatering.success: Even watering applied. Moisture is spreading more evenly again.

normalWatering.label: Normal watering pass
normalWatering.short: Stronger standard care when the root zone is ready.
normalWatering.description: Has more impact, but needs cleaner timing.
normalWatering.success: Normal watering completed. The plant has a solid moisture buffer again.

relieveRootZone.label: Relieve root zone
relieveRootZone.short: Only makes sense under salt or root-zone pressure.
relieveRootZone.description: Aims to ease pressure in the zone, not just dump in more water.
relieveRootZone.success: Root zone carefully relieved. Watch how calmly it settles now.

checkSupply.label: Check supply
checkSupply.short: Reads demand and uptake before feeding.
checkSupply.description: Helps you judge whether the plant can take a feed cleanly right now.
checkSupply.success: Supply checked. The next feeding decision is clearer now.

lightBase.label: Light base supply
lightBase.description: Adds a cautious baseline when the root zone looks stable enough.
lightBase.success: Light base supply given. The plant looks a bit better supported.

phaseSupply.label: Phase-aware supply
phaseSupply.short: Standard supply matched to the current phase.
phaseSupply.description: Works best when uptake, root zone and salt load line up.
phaseSupply.success: Phase-aware supply applied. Now watch whether uptake stays calm.

stabilizeUptake.label: Stabilise uptake
stabilizeUptake.short: Gentle support for unsettled or stressed conditions.
stabilizeUptake.description: Targets stability more than pushing hard growth.
stabilizeUptake.success: Uptake stabilised. Feeding pressure feels calmer now.

protectSaltLoad.label: Protect salt load
protectSaltLoad.short: Choose not to feed to avoid more pressure.
protectSaltLoad.description: Sometimes not feeding is the smarter care choice.
protectSaltLoad.success: Salt load protected. Less pressure is the better feed decision here.

checkLeaves.label: Check leaves
checkLeaves.short: Spots stress and deficiency signs earlier.
checkLeaves.description: Helps you read the plant before small issues turn bigger.
checkLeaves.success: Leaves checked. Signs will be easier to read now.

estimatePotWeight.label: Estimate pot weight
estimatePotWeight.short: Improves your feel for watering rhythm.
estimatePotWeight.description: Connects water feel, pot weight and moisture picture.
estimatePotWeight.success: Pot weight estimated. The watering rhythm is clearer now.

checkSubstrate.label: Check substrate
checkSubstrate.short: Links surface and root zone more clearly.
checkSubstrate.description: Helps you see whether top and bottom layers actually match.
checkSubstrate.success: Substrate checked. Surface and root zone are easier to compare now.

rotatePlant.label: Rotate plant
rotatePlant.description: Adds a bit of balance without a harsh intervention.
rotatePlant.success: Plant rotated. Growth should stay a little more even now.

hygieneRound.label: Hygiene round
hygieneRound.short: Keeps the environment calmer with less risk pressure.
hygieneRound.description: Lowers light pressure without stressing the plant directly.
hygieneRound.success: Hygiene round done. The environment feels cleaner and calmer again.

gentleStressCheck.label: Gentle stress check
gentleStressCheck.short: Small stabilising pass without invasive work.
gentleStressCheck.description: Helps ease pressure early instead of reacting too late.
gentleStressCheck.success: Gentle stress check done. The plant feels a little calmer now.
